retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist composition featuring a small, ornate central square painting set against a vast, textured red field.
triggerTerms: central square painting on red background
excludeWhen: a complex grid of multiple images is needed
the background must be a solid flat color without texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast layout defined by a massive red field with visible painterly brushstrokes, containing a small, centrally-aligned square artwork bordered by a thin gold frame. The inset art features grotesque, surrealist figures in a contrasting blue and tan palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme scale contrast between the large red field and the small central square
Warm gold frame acting as a bridge between the red field and the cool-toned inset art
Textured, expressive brushwork in the background mirroring the painterly style of the subject
Bottom-right corner anchor for metadata or advisory labels
coreInvariants: Visible oil paint texture across the entire red field
Thin, metallic gold border around the inset

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a small square centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 15% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central square is the primary anchor, while a small rectangular label in the bottom-right corner provides a secondary, functional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is immediately drawn to the high-contrast center, then radiates outward to the textured red expanse before settling on the bottom-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Massive use of active negative space (red texture) to create a sense of importance and isolation for the central image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant, warm red with subtle tonal variations from brushstrokes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and earthy tans within the central painting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for the thin frame border.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with a mix of mid-tones and highlights in the central figure work.
paletteRestrictions: Gold must be used only for the frame
Black and white reserved for corner metadata

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing within a boxed container
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard industrial legibility is prioritized
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif for a utilitarian, industrial look.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black and white container for text
Thin gold frame around the central image

avoid: Centering text over the main image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the corner label.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean industrial lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a large square canvas with a rich, textured red oil paint finish. In the exact center, place a small square oil painting featuring surrealist figures in blue and tan, surrounded by a thin gold leaf frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, rectangular black and white advisory label in the bottom-right corner using a bold, condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the central square perfectly centered?
Is the red background visibly textured with brushstrokes?
Is the gold frame thin and metallic?
Is the corner text contained within a black and white box?

adjustableVariables: Texture intensity of the red background
Subject matter of the central inset painting
Size ratio of the inset to the background
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific logos or trademarked characters in the central art
Do not use the exact wording from the advisory label; use generic placeholder text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red field has a matte oil-paint sheen
Check that the gold frame has a subtle metallic luster
Verify the corner label is legible and sharp
Confirm the central art style is consistent with expressive oil painting
recipe.reuseFormula: Large textured monochrome field + small centered framed inset + corner metadata block.
